sentences.ar: لما التقوا، كل واحد شاف الخوف بعين التاني.
sentences.en: When they met, each saw the fear in the other’s eye.
And fear looks a great deal like enmity.

sentences.ar: انخانقوا بلا ما حدا منهم بده.
sentences.en: They fought without either of them wanting to.
The ox died and the lion was wounded.
A little later, the lion sat grieving.
He said: I have lost the best friend I had.
